description: Before Bash, file edits, reads, MCP, scheduler and message tool calls (hooks/guard.mjs): deny OPR-01 breaches in the operator session and DEC-08 merge messages without the review trailer; classify outward git, gh and GitHub MCP actions for every session (destructive denied, shared asked where the permission mode prompts, else denied; under an unattended go only the pinned base push and a merged branch delete pass, with GitHub evidence); deny writes to ~/.claude, commit status and check run writes, and scheduler or message tools carrying /orbit:unattended in every mode, and reads of ~/.claude while a go code is pending. On UserPromptSubmit, handle /orbit:unattended (hooks/unattended.mjs: a one-time code on the owner's terminal, never in the conversation). After Write/Edit under the OKF bundle, run validate-okf (silent without a bundle or node); after a successful `git push`, append a push event, and an outward event for each shared or destructive action (class go for the go's own), to the session ledger (hooks/capture.mjs, fail-open, silent without a profile); at session start, resume, clear or compaction in the main checkout, hand .agents/operator.md to the operator (silent without it)
